answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy can grow trust like a trellis: each identity earns its place by doing verifiable work that links it to real peers, so a cloned army has no shared history to climb. An atlas of reputation records who vouched for whom, and one bad actor taints its whole cluster, making mass copies expensive. A falcon-style random audit then samples agents and demands fresh proof of unique resources, so fakes collapse while honest agents keep working.
